title: Spiced Sea Bass Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful Indian-inspired dish featuring marinated sea bass on skewers, grilled to perfection.
instructions: Cut the sea bass into 1-inch cubes and place in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, mix together cumin seeds, coriander seeds, ginger paste, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice mixture to the sea bass and mix until the fish is evenly coated.
Thread the marinated sea bass onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with Mediterranean olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sea bass is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as basmati rice or naan bread.
